instruction: Create suppression file from valgrind output

output:
cat > mylib.supp << 'EOF'
{
   <insert_a_suppression_name_here>
   Memcheck:Leak
   fun:malloc
   obj:/usr/lib/mylib.so
}
EOF

instruction: Suppress all leaks from function foo
output:
cat > foo.supp << 'EOF'
{
   suppress_foo
   Memcheck:Leak
   fun:foo
}
EOF

instruction: Suppress conditional jump based on uninit
output:
cat > uninit.supp << 'EOF'
{
   suppress_uninit
   Memcheck:Cond
   fun:bar
}
EOF

cat > overlap.supp << 'EOF'
{
   suppress_overlap
   Memcheck:Overlap
   fun:memcpy
}
EOF

cat > writev.supp << 'EOF'
{
   suppress_writev
   Memcheck:Param
   writev(vector)
   fun:writev
}
EOF

instruction: Show all suppressions used in run
Merge multiple suppressions in one file

output:
cat > file.supp << 'EOF'
{
   suppress_in_file
   Memcheck:Leak
   ...
   obj:/path/to/binary
}
EOF

cat > multi.supp << 'EOF'
{
   suppress_multi_match
   Memcheck:Leak
   match-leak-kinds: definite
   fun:malloc
   fun:foo
}
EOF

cat > caller.supp << 'EOF'
{
   suppress_by_caller
   Memcheck:Leak
   fun:malloc
   fun:my_function
}
EOF

cat > definite.supp << 'EOF'
{
   definite_leaks
   Memcheck:Leak
   match-leak-kinds: definite
   ...
}
EOF

cat > stack.supp << 'EOF'
{
   stack_suppress
   Memcheck:Leak
   fun:malloc
   fun:allocate
   fun:main
}
EOF
